mapper.select:
SELECT area.dept_id FROM sys_dept area WHERE area.del_flag = 0 and area.tenant_id is null and
area.dept_level > 2 AND area.dept_id = ( SELECT LEFT ( vuser.dept_id, 6 ) FROM sys_user vuser WHERE vuser.user_id = #{userId} ) OR ( area.dept_level = 2 and area.tenant_id is null and area.dept_id like CONCAT((SELECT LEFT ( vuser.dept_id, 4 ) FROM sys_user vuser WHERE vuser.user_id = #{userId}),'%') )

SELECT * from sys_dept WHERE del_flag = '0'
and DEPT_LEVEL < 4 and industry_code='999999'
and (PARENT_ID=#{deptId} or DEPT_ID=#{deptId})
and DEPT_ID=#{deptId}
select * from sys_dept where dept_id = #{deptId}

select distinct area_path from sys_management_area_t WHERE delete_flag = '0' and area_code in
#{item}

select distinct area_code from sys_management_area_t WHERE delete_flag = '0' and
area_path like CONCAT(#{item},'%')

select u.user_id, u.dept_id, u.user_name, u.user_type, u.nick_name, u.email, u.avatar, u.phonenumber, u.tel_phone, u.sex, u.status, u.user_source, u.del_flag, u.login_ip, u.login_date, u.create_by, u.create_time, u.remark, u.login_fail_num, u.enterprise_id, u.tenant_id, u.is_tenant_admin, d.parent_id, d.dept_name, d.parent_name, d.dept_level, d.order_num, d.leader, d.status as dept_status, d.ancestors, st.tenant_name, st.trade_info from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_tenant_info st on u.tenant_id = st.tenant_id where u.del_flag = '0' AND u.user_id = #{userId}

select r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_key, r.role_sort, r.data_scope, r.tenant_id, r.status, r.del_flag, r.create_time, r.remark, r.role_type, r.create_by from sys_role r left join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = r.role_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = ur.user_id where u.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT a.DEPT_ID FROM sys_dept a WHERE a.TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND a.DEPT_LEVEL = '1' AND a.DEL_FLAG = '0'

SELECT DISTINCT d.DEPT_ID from sys_dept d LEFT JOIN sys_role_dept rd ON d.DEPT_ID=rd.DEPT_ID LEFT JOIN sys_user_role r ON r.ROLE_ID = rd.ROLE_ID WHERE d.DEL_FLAG = 0 AND d.INDUSTRY_CODE = #{industryCode} AND r.user_id = #{userId}
SELECT d.DEPT_ID from sys_dept d where DEL_FLAG=0 and TENANT_ID=#{tenantId} AND d.INDUSTRY_CODE = #{industryCode}
SELECT DEPT_ID from sys_dept WHERE del_flag = '0' and DEPT_ID like concat(#{deptId},'%')

select province_code provinceCode,city_code cityCode,county_code countyCode from vm_organ_street_rel_t where industry_code = #{industryCode} and dept_id
#{item}

SELECT DISTINCT ot.province_id AS provinceCode, ot.city_id AS cityCode, ot.county_id AS countyCode FROM vm_organ_device_rel_t od LEFT JOIN vm_iot_device_t ot ON ot.device_code = od.device_code WHERE od.industry_code = #{industryCode} and ot.category_code = '1' and od.device_type = '10' and od.dept_id
#{item}
SELECT user_id from sys_user WHERE DEPT_ID LIKE concat('%',#{deptId},'%')

select id from vm_screen_data_config_count where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and industry_code = #{industryCode} and screen_id = #{screenId} and screen_type = #{screenType} and app_ver_code = #{appVerCode} and is_customize = '1'

SELECT DISTINCT sdc.data_code FROM vm_screen_data_config sdc left join vm_order_devices od on sdc.data_code = od.device_code WHERE sdc.delete_flag = '0' AND sdc.data_type = '0' AND od.delete_flag = '0' AND od.ord_status in (0,1,2) AND sdc.screen_data_config_id = #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT sdc.data_code FROM vm_screen_data_config sdc left join vm_order_sensor_devices od on sdc.data_code = od.device_code WHERE sdc.delete_flag = '0' AND sdc.data_type = '1' AND od.delete_flag = '0' AND od.ord_status in (0,1,2) AND od.category_code = '2' AND sdc.screen_data_config_id = #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT sdc.data_code FROM vm_screen_data_config sdc left join vm_order_sensor_devices od on sdc.data_code = od.device_code WHERE sdc.delete_flag = '0' AND sdc.data_type = '2' AND od.delete_flag = '0' AND od.ord_status in (0,1,2) AND od.category_code = '1' AND sdc.screen_data_config_id = #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT sdc.data_code FROM vm_screen_data_config sdc left join vm_order_horn_devices od on sdc.data_code = od.device_code WHERE sdc.delete_flag = '0' AND sdc.data_type = '3' AND od.delete_flag = '0' AND od.ord_status in (0,1,2) AND sdc.screen_data_config_id = #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT sdc.data_code FROM vm_screen_data_config sdc left join vm_order_uav_devices od on sdc.data_code = od.device_code WHERE sdc.delete_flag = '0' AND sdc.data_type = '4' AND od.delete_flag = '0' AND od.ord_status in (0,1,2) AND sdc.screen_data_config_id = #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT sdc.data_code FROM vm_screen_data_config sdc left join vm_order_recorder_devices od on sdc.data_code = od.device_code WHERE sdc.delete_flag = '0' AND sdc.data_type = '5' AND od.delete_flag = '0' AND od.ord_status in (0,1,2) AND sdc.screen_data_config_id = #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT sdc.data_code FROM vm_screen_data_config sdc left join bm_grid bg on sdc.data_code = bg.grid_id WHERE sdc.delete_flag = '0' AND sdc.data_type = '6' AND bg.delete_flag = '0' AND sdc.screen_data_config_id = #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT sdc.data_code FROM vm_screen_data_config sdc left join bm_gridkeeper bg on sdc.data_code = bg.keeper_id WHERE sdc.delete_flag = '0' AND sdc.data_type = '7' AND bg.delete_flag = '0' AND sdc.screen_data_config_id = #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT sdc.data_code FROM vm_screen_data_config sdc left join resource_conf rc on sdc.data_code = rc.RESOURCE_ID WHERE sdc.delete_flag = '0' AND sdc.data_type = '8' AND rc.delete_flag = '0' AND sdc.screen_data_config_id = #{id}
SELECT DISTINCT sdc.data_source as source, sdc.data_code as code FROM vm_screen_data_config sdc WHERE sdc.delete_flag = '0' AND sdc.data_type = '9' AND sdc.screen_data_config_id = #{id}

SELECT DISTINCT sat.type_value AS code, IFNULL(sat.alarm_source,'1') as source FROM vm_order_algorithms voa inner join vm_algorithm_info_t ai on voa.algorithm_code = ai.algorithm_code inner join vm_algorithm_alarm aa on ai.algo_min_type_code = aa.algo_min_type inner join sys_alarm_type sat ON aa.alarm_type = sat.type_value left join sys_dict_data dict on sat.alarm_source = dict.DICT_VALUE and dict.DICT_TYPE = 'warning_source_common' WHERE sat.delete_flag = 0 and sat.alarm_source = '1' and ai.delete_flag = 0 and aa.delete_flag = 0 and voa.delete_flag = 0 and sat.alarm_source = '1' and voa.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and voa.ord_status in (0, 1, 2) and voa.industry_code = #{industryCode} ORDER BY aa.alarm_type

SELECT distinct warning_source AS source, type_value AS code FROM vm_organ_alarm_type_rel_t WHERE delete_flag = 0 and tenant_id = #{tenantId} and industry_code = #{industryCode} and dept_id in
#{deptId}
select AREA_CODE, AREA_NAME from sys_area where AREA_LEVEL = 1 and DEL_FLAG = 0 limit 1
select DEPT_ID, DEPT_NAME from sys_dept where PARENT_ID = '0' and DEL_FLAG = 0 limit 1
select CONFIG_VALUE from sys_config where config_key = #{type}
